name: weaver-art
description: Arte computacional com fio contínuo sobre um tear circular — inspirado em 'A new way to knit' (2016), de Petros Vrellis.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-wasm.mjs && npm run build --workspace @weaver-art/core && npm run build --workspace @weaver-art/web && node scripts/sync-dist.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
